displayDescription: A headline about an idea becoming a system hands its highlighted term to a matching network node, then a key-fact bar settles.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: No preview recipes were listed in STYLE.json and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview shows the style's main action: reveal the key fact, link one term to its evidence, then hold.
The evidence pane is an original vector network diagram drawn as an example, not real data or footage.
Blender was not used. The scene is flat editorial vector art, built in SVG and animated with the local GSAP file. No depth, lighting or material effects were needed.
Text widths are measured once from the locally installed Georgia/Helvetica fonts to size the highlight and leader start. A different fallback font could change those sizes slightly.
The technology record could not be written because this preview workspace has no project dependency manifest. SVG is native and GSAP is the supplied local gsap.min.js.
